tooltip.essentialcraft5.solar_prism.en: Needs the 8 blocks around it empty and a block two steps away on each side, or it drops
tooltip.essentialcraft5.solar_prism.zh: 紧挨着的 8 格要空着、东南西北隔一格要有方块，否则会掉落

gui.essentialcraft5.sun_ray_absorber.hin.en: Makes this much MRU every tick while a solar beam hits it
gui.essentialcraft5.sun_ray_absorber.hin.zh: 被太阳光束照到时，每刻产出这么多 MRU

gui.essentialcraft5.sun_ray_absorber.hin.en: The MRU it makes is chaotic (balance 2.0)
gui.essentialcraft5.sun_ray_absorber.hin.zh: 产出的 MRU 是混沌的（平衡值 2.0）

gui.essentialcraft5.ender_generator.hint.en: Pulls nearby Endermen on top of itself and hits them
gui.essentialcraft5.ender_generator.hint.zh: 把附近的末影人拉到自己头顶来打

gui.essentialcraft5.ender_generator.hint.en: Every hit that lands makes this much MRU
gui.essentialcraft5.ender_generator.hint.zh: 每打中一次，产出这么多 MRU

tooltip.essentialcraft5.balance_setter.u.en: Sneak + right-click a machine to set its MRU balance to the mode
tooltip.essentialcraft5.balance_setter.u.zh: 潜行右键机器，把它的 MRU 平衡值设成当前模式

tooltip.essentialcraft5.balance_setter.u.en: Works only in Creative mode or for operators
tooltip.essentialcraft5.balance_setter.u.zh: 只在创造模式下或管理员手里生效

message.essentialcraft5.balance_setter.n.en: Only usable in Creative mode or by operators
message.essentialcraft5.balance_setter.n.zh: 只有创造模式或管理员才能使用
